title: PCR Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare samples for transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 24 RNA samples into 4 different mastermixes according to the provided deck layout.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck modules and labware exactly as shown in the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tiprack, and the pipette using the OT App; refer to support articles for calibration tips.
